name: progalaxyelabs/stonescriptphp-payments
description: The unified payment system for StoneScriptPHP — merges what were separately-published stonescriptphp-pay (Razorpay/PayPal transport drivers) and stonescriptphp-invoice (SQL-first billing/invoicing) into one package: gateway drivers, the idempotent payment-capture primitive, and SQL-first subscription/one-time/credit/wallet/consumption/passthrough pricing, invoices, parties, pluggable regional tax computation (ships India GST), gateway routing, and durable transactional-outbox intimation. All business logic lives in PostgreSQL functions deployed via the StoneScriptDB Gateway; PHP is transport only.

suggest.progalaxyelabs/stonescriptphp: Required (>= 12.0) ONLY by the framework adapters: src/Php/InvoiceSourceAdapter.php (StoneScriptPHP\Billing\Contracts\InvoiceSource), src/Http/Webhook/DatabaseFnCaller.php (Database::fn / Database::mutate), src/Http/Entitlement/EntitlementMiddleware.php and FrameworkMainDbScope.php, and src/Http/Routes/PostWebhookRoute.php. The SQL, the drivers and the pure-PHP classes (EntitlementGuard, EntitlementOperations, WalletOperations) never need the framework.
